items.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to one billion users
items.summary: Gemini is keeping pace with OpenAI’s ChatGPT, which hit 1 billion monthly active users back in June.

items.title: Bluesky’s active user base is shrinking as its focus expands beyond the app
items.summary: Over a year following its post-election surge, Bluesky’s mobile app is seeing a continued decline in active users, though its remaining community is still relatively engaged.

items.title: What’s Scaleup Europe, the $5.7B fund that just backed satellite company ICEYE?
items.summary: Scaleup Europe, a public-private fund with a $5.7 billion target, made its first investment by backing Finnish satellite company ICEYE.

items.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
items.summary: One of OpenAI's longest-serving executives is headed out the door, although the longtime COO told staff that he was "excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."

items.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
items.summary: River AI, a startup founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a fascinating vision for personal agents and secured $1.1 billion out of the gate.

items.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
items.summary: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

items.title: Joby Aviation builds out defense business with $500M acquisition
items.summary: Joby Aviation reached an agreement to acquire Resonant Sciences, which will kick off its new defense business.

items.title: Delta investigating after someone set up fake Wi-Fi network mid-flight
items.summary: The Delta flight crew switched off the aircraft's legitimate Wi-Fi network for around 30 minutes due to the incident, according to a spokesperson.

items.title: 2025’s most downloaded game, Block Blast!, is going ad-free on Apple Arcade
items.summary: Block Blast!, the most downloaded mobile game of 2025, is coming to Apple Arcade in September, where it will be ad-free.

items.title: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe is betting on EVs, robots, and autonomy all at once — he’ll explain why at Disrupt 2026
items.summary: Rivian's CEO RJ Scaringe is speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to detail his journey, and the lessons it’s bestowed.

items.title: FlightAware sues Kalshi over flight cancellation prediction markets
items.summary: FlightAware says that Kalshi used its name and data to offer bets on flight cancellations without the flight tracker's permission.

items.title: Kyoto Fusioneering starts work on key fusion power plant device
items.summary: Fusion power startups are turning to Kyoto Fusioneering to supply components for future power plants. The Japan-based startup just received a grant to build a part of the fuel system.

items.title: Bumble ditches its rule that kept men from making the first move
items.summary: Bumble is ditching the rule that it has enforced since launching in 2024. Men can finally message first.

items.title: North Korean remote IT staffer worked for US government agency, says FBI
items.summary: The investigation shows that North Koreans are able to infiltrate government agencies, as well as private organizations and crypto exchanges.

items.title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
items.summary: Spotify is introducing “AI Persona” labels for artist profiles that represent AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

items.title: What comes after the smartphone? Amazon’s Panos Panay will make his case at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: At Disrupt 2026, Amazon's Panos Panay will provide his vision for what's in store for us beyond the smartphone.

items.title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
items.summary: Anthropic will extend support for watermarking AI generations for older models as well.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly completed a $7 billion employee tender offer
items.summary: San Francisco's housing market is in trouble again.

items.title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model with it.

items.title: Jeff Bezos might finally get his hands on a sports team
items.summary: Jeff Bezos is reportedly close to buying his first stake in a sports team: the U.K.'s famed Liverpool Football Club.
